Package org.example.view

Interface ISimulatorUI

All Known Implementing Classes:
SimulatorGUI
public interface ISimulatorUI
Interface defining the user interface contract for the pizzeria simulation.

Provides abstract getter and setter methods for retrieving user configuration inputs (simulation duration, delay, workstation capacities, service durations, and customer distribution weights) and delivering engine simulation results back to the GUI view layer.
